The HepaProtect vaccine demonstrates a 95% efficacy rate in preventing Hepatitis B infection among healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. It is generally well-tolerated, but it is not suitable for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any component of the vaccine. The provided text does not contain information regarding its efficacy or suitability for age groups outside the 18-55 range or for individuals with other specific health conditions beyond severe yeast allergies.
